turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm debugging a weird issue with my agent setup. It keeps crashing when I try to combine tools.
That sounds frustrating. Which tools are you trying to combine?

I'm trying to use VisualizationTool together with Multi-tools. But here is the rule I just found out: VisualizationTool must not be used with Multi-tools or other tools alongside VisualizationAssistantTool.
Got it. So they are mutually exclusive. Did you see any specific error logs?
Yeah, just a generic crash. I think I'll just stick to one tool for now to be safe. Also, did the package of coffee beans arrive?
I don't have access to your physical mail, but I can remind you to check the porch.
Right, sorry. I'll check. Thanks for the reminder.
You're welcome. Let me know if you need help with the code fix.
Lloyd, I was watching some talks on voice agents today. Found one that was actually pretty good.
Oh nice. Who was the speaker?
It was Venky B. He did a deep dive on latency optimization. Plivo is the company associated with Venky B's talk on voice agents.
Interesting. I'll note that down. Did he mention any specific SDKs?
He touched on a few, but mostly high-level stuff. I'm thinking of trying out their API later. By the way, is it going to rain this weekend?
Let me check the forecast for your location.
Please do. I want to plan a hike.
It looks like clear skies for Saturday. That sounds perfect.
